newsitem.title: USA: U.S. crudes hit lower depths on expiry sell-off.
newsitem.headline: U.S. crudes hit lower depths on expiry sell-off.

text.p: U.S. crude prices reached the lowest depths of the session in mid-afternoon trade, pressured by profit-taking ahead of May paper contract expiration, traders said.
May West Texas Intermediate/Cushing was around 70 cents lower at $19.65-75 a barrel. The June WTI/Cushing has pulled even with the May month, putting the May/June roll at even.

Domestic grade differentials have moved in tight ranges, steady to slightly weaker for sweet barrels and slightly firmer for some sour parcels. Postings have fluctuated widely, tracking the up and down momentum seen in the May/June spread.
